description: Bridge patterns map neural mechanisms to business signatures and back. Each pattern is a CLAIM that two literatures describe the same underlying pathology — and that clinical treatments for the neural side suggest interventions for the business side, and vice versa. derivedAngles per pattern are the seeds that the 6 engine lanes (patent/grant/sba/franchise/investment/research) consume to produce concrete artifacts.

neural.mechanism: Reward-prediction-error signal decouples from outcome learning. Dopaminergic input from VTA persists despite negative-outcome feedback. Tonic firing replaces phasic learning.
knownTreatments: TMS to dlPFC for top-down control
clinicalReferences: Volkow ND 2016 Annu Rev Pharmacol Toxicol

business.description: Growth pursued at any cost — SG&A and CAC accelerate while gross margins compress. Discounting and option-grant inflation replace organic growth. Forward guidance prioritized over outcome learning.

bridge.rationale: Both involve reward-circuit hyperactivation prioritizing short-term signal over outcome-aligned regulation. Both respond to top-down control restoration (TMS-to-dlPFC for NAcc; board-level capital-discipline restoration for revenue-chase).

patent.claimDirection: System and method for detecting corporate revenue-chase signature via reward-prediction-error decoupling metric applied to SG&A vs GM trajectory
patent.noveltyAnchor: First application of NAcc-equivalent tonic-hyperactivation detection to corporate financial signal

grant.angle: Translational research applying contingency-management protocols to corporate compensation design

investment.thesis: Short companies entering revenue-chase signature; long companies with restored capital discipline post-board intervention

research.hypothesis: Companies in revenue-chase signature respond to contingency-management-equivalent interventions (board-level reward restructuring)
research.methodology: longitudinal comparison of incentive-restructured vs control firms
